The Concept

Some legends never chip.

We treat the discontinued winter shades like a band that split up and is reuniting for one tour. Every touchpoint borrows the language of a music comeback — the setlist, the greatest hits, the encore, the reissue, the presale.

It works because it hands us two things for free: nostalgia (the fans already love these shades and have been asking for them) and scarcity ("one season only / limited pressing"). The campaign builds anticipation, then rewards it — and it plugs straight into the Winter Vault reveal already teased for September.

Tone: confident, a little tongue-in-cheek, unmistakably a comeback. Poster ink, stage lights, vinyl inserts — not snowflakes and glitter.

The Rollout · 6 Beats

Order of Play

1Announce

The Tour Poster

Festival gig-poster line-up with the winter shades as headliners. The announcement drop — already prototyped in the existing render.

"One season only."

2Reveal

The Setlist Drop

Carousel that reveals the shades one "track" at a time — each slide a swatch on skin plus a lyric-style caption.

"Track 03 just dropped."

3Hero

The Comeback Single

One hero shade drops first as the "lead single." The whole teaser week orbits it before the full collection lands.

"The single you streamed to death."

4Engage

The Encore

A fan-voted bonus shade that unlocks if the drop sells out — the natural home for the Winter Vault vote.

"One more! One more!"

5Convert

Backstage Pass

The email list becomes the VIP list: 24-hour early access before the public drop. Rewards loyalty, drives sign-ups now.

"Doors open early for the list."

6Proof

The Reissue

"Remastered, not remade" — same formula, same bottle. A then-and-now split that answers the "is it really the same?" question.

"Loved then. Iconic now."

For the Designer

Art Direction

Palette

#D43790Brand Pink

#141414Stage Ink

#F3EEE4Insert Cream

#C8D3DEIcy Silver

Typography

The Reunion
Display · condensed poster grotesque (Impact / Anton / Druk family)
Body copy & captions
Body · clean humanist sans (Montserrat / Helvetica Neue)
Track 01 · One Season Only
Labels · monospace, uppercase, wide-tracked

Mood

Lean into
  • Gig posters, tour merch, vinyl sleeves & inserts
  • Stage lighting, spotlights, high contrast
  • Ticket stubs, setlists, backstage passes, barcodes
  • Bold condensed type, big and loud
  • The real bottles as the "band members"
Avoid
  • Literal snowflakes, glitter, generic "winter"
  • Soft pastel gradients & script fonts
  • Stock-photo hands / holiday clichés
  • Anything that reads as a seasonal sale banner

Formats per concept

1:1 feed 1080×1080 · 9:16 story/reel 1080×1920 · web banner 1600×600 · email header 1200×600
